# Synthetic provider fixtures

These examples were manually authored from field names, enumerated event kinds, and public producer definitions. Every identifier, path, timestamp, message, command, and output is invented. No genuine transcript was copied or transformed into a fixture.

Codex: observed writer 0.153.4 and pinned openai/codex rust-v0.153.4 protocol and rollout source. Claude: observed writer 2.1.260 and official Claude session/subagent storage documentation. Hermes tests construct schema-26-shaped sessions/messages tables in temporary databases from installed hermes_state_common.py field definitions. Full provenance and limits: docs/providers.md; private local evidence is excluded from distribution.
